messages:
Jordan (cust): Hey team — our product analytics dashboard on mobile is showing the chart series colors and legend labels swapped. Tooltip also shows values for a different series when I tap a slice. Screenshot: https://example.com/snap/abc123.png

alice: @Jordan sorry about that. Can you confirm which org and which dashboard/view? Mobile OS/browser?

Jordan (cust): Org: org-472, dashboard: 'usage-over-time' (the default chart). iPhone 14, iOS 17.2, Safari. Happens on Chrome on iOS too. Happened after yesterday's deploy (approx 11:30 UTC).

ben: Thanks — assigning to mobile-team and eng-infra to triage. Any flaky deploys around 11:30? @sre-oncall FYI.

sre-oncall: deploy-bot reported a rollout for analytics-api v2.7.1 at 11:28 UTC, no alerts. No infra incidents.

deploy-bot: [deployment] analytics-api v2.7.1 -> stable rolled out at 2025-03-07T11:28:14Z :white_check_mark:

alice: Can you repro and share repro steps? Does desktop web show the same?

Jordan (cust): Desktop looks fine. Only mobile. Steps: open app > Console > Dashboards > select 'usage-over-time' > tap legend on top to toggle series. The colors shown in legend don't match the drawn line colors; tapping a series highlights a different line. Tooltips when you tap a point show the value for the series that was toggled, not the one you tapped.

mobile-team: Repro'd on iPhone 14 simulator. Looks like the legend entries are being rendered in a different order than the series on the canvas. Suspect CSS flex-wrap or the chart library re-ordering legend items when width goes below threshold. Will capture console logs.

mobile-team: Console log when loading:
```
ChartRenderer: seriesOrder: ["p95_latency","p50_latency","errors","throughput"]
LegendRenderer: items: ["throughput","errors","p50_latency","p95_latency"]
```

mobile-team: The chart library (lightchart.js v3.2.0) renders series in internal order but our legend build code iterates over the API's metricsMap keys — which are coming back as an object not an array. Looks like the API switched to returning a metrics map instead of an array in v2.7.1 which changed property iteration order on mobile (JS engine differences).

ben: Good catch. So desktop JS (V8) preserved insertion order in that environment; Safari/WebKit on iOS enumerates object keys differently under certain optimizations. That would explain platform-specific mismatch.

alice: Can you paste the payload from the analytics API for org-472 when the dashboard loads? We need to confirm shape.

mobile-team: Payload excerpt:
```
{
  "metrics": {
    "throughput": {"series": [...]},
    "errors": {"series": [...]},
    "p50_latency": {"series": [...]},
    "p95_latency": {"series": [...]} 
  },
  "series_order": null
}
```

mobile-team: Previously v2.6.x returned "metrics": [{"id":"throughput",...}, ...] (an array). The new response is a map.

alice: Root cause seems to be the backend change to a map for compactness. Our front-end relied on order preservation. Fix options: 1) Backend change to return array or include explicit series_order field; 2) Frontend normalize by sorting keys using expected order or by stable sort on metric id; 3) Generate legend from the chart's internal series array instead of the payload.

ben: Short-term patch: frontend can build legend from ChartRenderer.seriesOrder so rendering matches the canvas. Can we ship that as a mobile/console hotfix?

mobile-team: We can patch the mobile web bundle (console frontend) to derive legend items from ChartRenderer.seriesOrder and ship a quick release (rollback-safe). Preparing PR now.

alice: @analytics-api team — please prioritize adding a non-breaking field series_order (array) to the response in the next minor so we don't rely on engine-specific object key ordering.

analytics-api (via ben): Noted. We'll add series_order and keep map for compactness. Target v2.7.2.

mobile-team: Quickfix PR: https://repo.internal/console/pull/6543 — changes legend builder to use chart.seriesOrder if available, fallback to metrics keys. Added unit tests.

deploy-bot: [staging deploy] console-web v1.18.5 -> staging at 2025-03-07T16:02:05Z :rocket:

mobile-team: Verified on staging: legend matches canvas, tooltips correct, no swap on iOS Safari simulator. Regression test added.

Jordan (cust): Thanks! Any ETA for production fix? Our users are blocked on mobile reporting.

alice: We'll promote the hotfix to prod once we finish smoke tests. Targeting 2-hour window. Will update when live. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: [production deploy] console-web v1.18.5 -> prod at 2025-03-07T18:10:12Z :rocket: :shipit:

mobile-team: Post-deploy checks good on iPhone 14 device. Legend order now matches series and tooltips show the correct values.

Jordan (cust): Confirmed fixed on my phone. Thank you all for the quick turnaround :tada:

alice: Closing the escalation. Action items:
- analytics-api: include series_order field (ben)
- console: keep legend fallback and add tests (mobile-team)
- support: notify Jordan when v2.7.2 rolls out (alice)

ben: Created follow-up ticket INF-3219 to add series_order and deprecate map-only responses.

sre-oncall: No related infra alerts. Marking incident as resolved. :white_check_mark:
